'''Loijin Plaza''' was an area on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], there was a rumour that [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] were advancing across the area.<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>
